_meta.description: SIEM field names per index for SOC-Hunter. Use as reference to construct correct queries on first attempt. Populate this file with fields from your actual environment using your SIEM's fieldsummary / field discovery tools.
_meta.how_to_populate: Run `| fieldsummary` (Splunk), `_source` inspection (Elastic), or equivalent against each index and record the key fields here.
_meta.purpose: Eliminate field-discovery retries. The agent queries any SPL/KQL it needs — this only tells it WHAT FIELDS EXIST in each index.

<vm_inventory_index>.notes: CRITICAL: Check your SIEM forwarder field names. The 'host' field is often the forwarder, NOT the scanned asset. Use your VM platform's asset hostname field for endpoint identity.

identity.asset_hostname: Scanned endpoint hostname (primary identifier — verify field name in your environment)

finding.output: Full plugin output text (may be multiline)

<auth_index>.notes: Identity provider / SSO logs. Field names vary significantly by provider (Okta vs Azure AD vs Google Workspace vs Auth0).

event.action: Event action (login, logout, MFA, policy change, etc.)

<endpoint_os_index>.notes: Windows Event Logs / Linux auditd from servers and DCs. Field names vary by forwarder (WinEventLog add-on, Splunk UF, Elastic agent, etc.).

<edr_index>.notes: EDR alert / detection events forwarded to SIEM. Field names vary by EDR platform.

<scm_audit_index>.notes: SCM audit logs (GitHub Enterprise Cloud, GitLab, Bitbucket, etc.). Field names vary by platform and forwarder.

<artifact_registry_index>.notes: Artifact registry logs (JFrog Artifactory, Nexus, etc.). Field names vary by forwarder.

<cloud_audit_index>.notes: Cloud API audit logs (AWS CloudTrail, Azure Activity, GCP Audit, etc.). Field names vary by provider and forwarder.

<dns_index>.notes: DNS query logs. Field names vary by DNS platform (Umbrella, Infoblox, Windows DNS, PowerDNS, etc.).

query.record_type: Query type (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, etc.)

<casb_index>.notes: CASB/SSE events (Netskope, Zscaler, Menlo, etc.). Field names vary by platform.

application_event.activity: Activity type (upload, download, post, share, etc.)
application_event.category: App category (Generative AI, Cloud Storage, etc.)
